subject: Animation
title: Pixar's 22 Rules of Storytelling
description: A micro-lesson that makes Pixar's 22 Rules of Storytelling usable.

hook.text: In 2011, Pixar storyboard artist Emma Coats tweeted 22 rules of storytelling that went viral online.

buildup.text: The rules included gems like: coincidences that get characters into trouble are great — to get out, lazy.

discovery.text: Rule four said: simplify, focus, combine characters, and hop over detours. Efficiency drives clarity.

twist.text: The rules were not official Pixar doctrine. They came from one artist's personal notes and observations.

climax.text: Despite being informal, the rules captured Pixar's storytelling philosophy better than any press release.

punchline.text: One artist's tweet thread became a storytelling bible.

quiz.question: Where did Pixar's famous 22 rules of storytelling come from?
options: Personal notes tweeted by storyboard artist Emma Coats that went viral
A book written by Ed Catmull

details.summary: Pixar artist Emma Coats distilled the studio's storytelling philosophy into 22 rules that circulated widely online. Principles like starting with once upon a time and simplifying by combining characters codified Pixar's approach to narrative craft.
details.whyItMatters: The 22 rules demonstrate that Pixar's storytelling success is built on learnable principles, not mysterious talent. They show that narrative craft can be studied, practiced, and improved — an empowering idea for aspiring storytellers.
takeaways: Pixar artist Emma Coats compiled 22 storytelling principles from studio wisdom
Rules emphasize character wants, simplification, and audience empathy
The principles went viral online and are widely taught in storytelling courses

faq.question: What are some of Pixar's most important storytelling rules?
faq.answer: Give your characters opinions. Coincidences that get characters into trouble are great; coincidences that get them out are cheating. Come up with your ending before you figure out your middle. Simplify, focus, combine characters. These practical principles guide Pixar's creative process.

faq.question: Are the 22 rules officially endorsed by Pixar?
faq.answer: They were compiled by story artist Emma Coats from lessons learned at Pixar and shared on her personal social media. Pixar has not officially adopted or endorsed them, but they accurately reflect the studio's storytelling philosophy as understood by someone who worked there.
